SELECT c.name AS client_name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.id = s.client_id
WHERE c.region = '서울'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM companyx.sales WHERE quarter = '2025-Q3'

SELECT AVG(s.amount) AS avg_monthly_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'security'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT e.name, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'
SELECT c.name FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.projects p ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.status = 'in_progress' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT companyx.support_tickets.id, companyx.support_tickets.title, companyx.support_tickets.description, companyx.support_tickets.priority, companyx.support_tickets.created_at, companyx.support_tickets.resolved_at, companyx.clients.name AS client_name, companyx.products.name AS product_name, companyx.employees.name AS assignee_name FROM companyx.support_tickets JOIN companyx.clients ON companyx.support_tickets.client_id = companyx.clients.id JOIN companyx.products ON companyx.support_tickets.product_id = companyx.products.id JOIN companyx.employees ON companyx.support_tickets.assignee_id = companyx.employees.id WHERE companyx.support_tickets.priority = 'critical' AND companyx.support_tickets.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')

SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM companyx.products p
JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM companyx.departments d JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
WHERE c.region = '부산' AND s.quarter = '2025-Q4'

SELECT 
  p.category, 
  SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, 
  c.region 
FROM 
  companyx.sales s 
JOIN 
  companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id 
JOIN 
  companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id 
WHERE 
  p.category IN ('security', 'cloud') 
  AND c.region = '대전' 
  AND s.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' 
GROUP BY 
  p.category, 
  c.region
SELECT (SELECT price_monthly FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-D1') - (SELECT price_monthly FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-D2') AS price_difference
SELECT name, version, release_date FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-C4'
SELECT contact_name, contact_email FROM companyx.clients WHERE name = 'Client-N'
SELECT name || ' (' || hire_date || ')' AS employee_info FROM companyx.employees WHERE hire_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-07-31'

SELECT e.name, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
WHERE e.salary BETWEEN 4000 AND 5000 AND e.is_active = true

SELECT st.title, st.created_at, c.name AS client_name
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id
WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status = 'open'

SELECT 
  companyx.support_tickets.title,
  companyx.support_tickets.created_at,
  companyx.support_tickets.resolved_at
FROM 
  companyx.support_tickets
JOIN 
  companyx.clients ON companyx.support_tickets.client_id = companyx.clients.id
WHERE 
  companyx.clients.name = 'Client-X' 
  AND companyx.support_tickets.status IN ('resolved', 'closed')

SELECT st.title, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) AS time_taken
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
WHERE st.status = 'resolved' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM st.created_at) = 2025
ORDER BY time_taken DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name AS client_name, ct.end_date FROM companyx.contracts ct JOIN companyx.clients c ON ct.client_id = c.id WHERE ct.end_date >= '2026-10-01' AND ct.end_date < '2026-11-01' AND ct.status = 'active'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, c.amount, c.start_date, c.end_date
FROM companyx.contracts c
JOIN companyx.products p ON c.product_id = p.id
JOIN companyx.clients cl ON c.client_id = cl.id
WHERE cl.name = 'Client-B' AND c.contract_type = 'subscription'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, p.price_monthly, pr.budget, pr.start_date
FROM companyx.products p
JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id
JOIN companyx.projects pr ON c.id = pr.contract_id
JOIN companyx.clients cl ON pr.client_id = cl.id
WHERE cl.name = 'Client-E' AND p.name = 'Client-E 로그 분석 시스템'
SELECT name FROM companyx.projects WHERE status = 'on_hold' AND end_date IS NULL

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.region
FROM companyx.clients c
WHERE c.industry = '의료/바이오'

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.registered_at
FROM companyx.clients c
ORDER BY c.registered_at ASC
LIMIT 5
SELECT T1.sale_date, T1.amount FROM companyx.sales AS T1 JOIN companyx.products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Product-S2' AND T1.quarter = '2025-Q1'
SELECT e.name AS employee_name, e.salary, e.hire_date FROM companyx.employees e WHERE e.name = '김준혁'

SELECT 
  contract_type, 
  COUNT(*) AS cancelled_contracts
FROM 
  companyx.contracts
WHERE 
  start_date >= '2025-01-01' 
  AND end_date IS NOT NULL 
  AND status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
  contract_type

SELECT s.sale_date, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
WHERE c.region = '서울' AND s.quarter = '2026-Q2'
GROUP BY s.sale_date
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1
